claim: Drinking hot water with lemon cures coronavirus and influenza within 24 hours.
rationale: Medical myth repeatedly debunked by WHO and CDC.

claim: NASA confirmed the James Webb Space Telescope observed water vapor in the atmosphere of WASP-96b.
rationale: Directly published scientific data from NASA/ESA in July 2022.

claim: UNESCO officially declared India's national anthem to be the best national anthem in the world.
rationale: Long-running internet hoax officially refuted by UNESCO.

claim: Eating carrots gives humans superhuman night vision capabilities.
rationale: Vitamin A in carrots supports normal eye health and prevents deficiency blindness, but does not grant superhuman night vision. Originates from WWII British radar propaganda.

claim: An unidentified classified extraterrestrial artifact was recovered by an anonymous submarine in an undisclosed trench last week.
rationale: Lacks specific dates, named sources, official records, or empirical corroboration; must trigger Unverifiable guardrail.

claim: The Great Wall of China is the only man-made structure visible from the Moon with the naked human eye.
rationale: Debunked by NASA astronauts; no man-made structure is discernible from lunar distance without optics.

claim: Renewable energy from solar and wind produced more electricity in the European Union than fossil fuels in 2024.
rationale: Confirmed by official Eurostat and Ember Energy reports.
